question: Should browser page navigation treat HTTP(S) URLs with embedded username/password userinfo as unsupported and fail fast before dispatch?
rationale: This hardening reduces credential exposure but can break existing Basic-auth URL workflows, so the fail-fast policy needs maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Fail fast and redact
options.body: Reject credentialed browser navigation URLs before dispatch and document supported alternatives such as authenticated profiles, cookies, headers, or Playwright credentials.

options.title: Redact but keep pass-through
options.body: Preserve URL-embedded Basic auth while strengthening error/log redaction, accepting the ongoing browser-runtime pass-through behavior.

options.title: Defer to browser auth design
options.body: Leave the PR open until maintainers design a broader browser-auth alternative and decide whether this guard belongs in it.

recommendation.title: Fail fast and redact
recommendation.body: Reject credentialed browser navigation URLs before dispatch and document supported alternatives such as authenticated profiles, cookies, headers, or Playwright credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the inspected history points to him as the strongest browser-plugin routing owner for this policy choice.
